key: Whew! Just got back from the longest trip I've had on the lake in as long as I can remember!
en: Whew! Just got back from the longest trip I've had on the lake in as long as I can remember!
ja: ふう! こんなに長い湖の旅は久しぶりだったな!

key: Now it's time for drink, rest and booze!
en: Now it's time for drink, rest and booze!
ja: さあ、飲んで、休んで、酒盛りの時間だ!

key: I finally got a job out on the lake.
en: I finally got a job out on the lake.
ja: やっと湖での仕事にありついたよ。

key: Just let me lay here for a while... I'll be fine.
en: Just let me lay here for a while... I'll be fine.
ja: しばらくここで横にならせてくれ……大丈夫だから。
